items.label: Adjustable height ＆Rolling
items.value: This side table with wheels can be adjusted height to suit bathtub, couch, bed, and chairs, while the swivel table can be rotated 360°. The C shaped end table is designed with smooth-rolling wheels so that it slides nicely under the sofa.desk.bed . It is very convenient and smooth to move, and you can switch usage scenarios at any time according to your needs.

items.label: Multi-functional small table
items.value: This side table is made of thicker steel frame and thickened wood boards to ensure its stability, it can hold laptop, books, drinks, snacks . you can use swivel side table to work, you can also use it as a couch tray for snacks, drinks and other items. Both top and bottom can hold items to save more space.

items.label: Prevents falling & Easy to clean
items.value: The edges of this snack table has a concave tabletop design. which is great for preventing coffee, foods from slipping out. Meanwhile, the selected tabletop material, wood c table is heat resistant, waterproof and easier to clean.

items.label: Unrivaled Stability
items.value: The c table end table stands out for its excellent stability. wood side table features a sturdy and heavy base, providing unparalleled stability.bed side table is not only rust proof, but also has a maximum load-bearing capacity of up to 50 pounds, it perfect for various home decoration styles.

items: Easy to Assemble：This rolling side table is solidly constructed and easy to understand.you can install it with ease. Any problem, please contact us.
